indices: 思い切って 妊娠 為る(する){してる} の と 告げる と 彼(かれ) は 俺(おれ) の 子(こ) だ と 言う の か と 言う{言った}

original: 「私は同じほうへ行くからタクシーを呼んで一緒に乗らない？」と言うようなことを言った。

en.text: They said something to the effect of ‘I’m going in the same direction so, I’ll call a taxi and then why don’t you ride with me?’

original: お願いだからそんなこと言わないで。

en.text: Please don't say that.

original: 彼女が俺に一緒に来て欲しいと言うんだ。

en.text: She says that she wants me to come with her.

original: アメリカ合衆国では誰もが大統領になれると言う。しかし実のところ事実ではないかもしれない。

en.text: They say that in America anyone can become president, but perhaps that's not really true.
They say that in the United States anyone can become president, but perhaps that's not really true.

original: 彼は調和と言う言葉を知らない。

en.text: That guy doesn't know the meaning of the word harmony.

original: 変なこと言うな！

en.text: Don't be so perverse!

original: 男はみんな同じと言う女性は大嫌いだ。

en.text: I hate it when women say that all men are the same.
I hate women who say that all men are the same.

original: １００年を１世紀と言う。

en.text: One hundred years is called a century.
A hundred years is called a century.
100 years is called a century.

original: フランス語は習得が容易だと言う人もいる。

en.text: Some people say French is easy to learn.

original: 当たり前のこと言うなよ。

en.text: Don't state the obvious.

original: 大概の喫煙者は禁煙したいと言う。

en.text: Most smokers say that they want to quit.

original: 本当に日本語が堪能な人は、そんなこと言わないって。

en.text: People who are actually good at Japanese don't say that they are.

original: 「忙しい」と言う字は心が亡くなると書く。

en.text: The kanji in "busy" is written as "the heart has died".

original: 二度とそんなこと言わないで。

en.text: Don't ever say that again.
Never say that again.

original: 奈良と言う小さな町で生まれました。

en.text: I was born in a small town called Nara.

original: お願いだから、そんなこと言わないで！

en.text: For goodness' sake, don't say that!

original: 笑顔で怖いこと言わないでよ。

en.text: Don't say scary things with a smile.

original: 無茶苦茶なこと言うなよ。

en.text: Don't be absurd.

original: 誰もそんなこと言わないよ。

en.text: No one would say that.
Nobody would say that.

original: 水臭いこと言うなよ、一緒に行こう。

en.text: Don't be aloof, let's go together.

original: 猫が生理的に水を嫌うと言う意味は、水に対する猫の自然な反応だ。

en.text: To say that a cat is instinctively averse to water means that it is the cat's natural reaction towards it.

original: 「雄弁は銀、沈黙は金」と言う人もいる。

en.text: Some say that speech is worth silver, but silence is worth gold.

original: 変なこと言わないでよ。

en.text: Don't say weird things like that.
Don't say weird things.

original: 開発関係者は、二倍の性能を実現したと言うが、実用では少し改善した程度に過ぎなかった。

en.text: Developers claim to have doubled its performance, but really it was only a slight improvement.

original: 罰当たりなこと言うな。

en.text: Don't say accursed things.
